findings.issue: Common noun (construct) left untranslated as torá; it is not a proper name.
Qal imperfect 3fs: the feminine noun is what goes out. del que saliere makes a masculine person the one who goes out.
Preposition suffix is 1st common plural (from us). desde él is 3rd masculine singular.
Feminine construct noun of lying/emission rendered as a deposit site.
Qal infinitive construct has no reflexive stem; se is grammatical smoothing.

notes: semilla matches the absolute seed noun; en ella matches the 3fs suffix.
